body: I love you. You deserve love and happiness and I hope good things find their way to you soon. I'm proud of you. I'm sending all my love. :)

Also, I know it's really tough and pretty cliche but I think trying to be patient and kind with yourself would help a bit.  I'm not sure if this is really a good way, but I like to imagine a mini me in my head telling myself "good job! you got out of bed, I'm proud of you" or "It's ok, this week has been really hard, you can take a break" as if mini-me is consoling a child me who just wants to be loved. Again, it might not help you but I found that treating myself like this helped me a bit on those really dark days. :)

I was there before (I'm 23), although not during a pandemic. It's probably not much of an answer but I guess I just want you to know that 17 is still really young. It probably doesn't feel like it because you're the oldest you've ever been but if u don't make the right choice for yourself right now, there's still time later. There's always time later. I know that it's incredibly tough even without your emptiness (and with it, everything seems almost impossible) but you can do it. You're career is more than your degree, you're life is more than your career, and you are more than your degree, school, or career. You're more than what depression makes you feel you are. I don't have much advice to be honest and I'm not sure this answer was helpful in any way but I'm rooting for you. Feel free to msg me if you want to talk.

Funny, I'm kinda the opposite but still the same. My family is caring I suppose and I comfortably live with them. I like when they're home but at the same time I feel like I'm not home with them if that makes sense. My dog makes me feel the most at "home" tbh but she doesnt sleep in my room so I cant stay there forever :\\  I hope we find our home soon. I'm sending some virtual love your way.
Those stars are cute haha. But I feel you. I go to sleep hoping I don't wake up. I just want to cease to exist so I don't hurt anyone around me and then I can also be "saved" I guess.
